recognize_zh: 中央有一個與紅血球差不多大、無核、充滿紫色顆粒且邊緣呈毛邊狀的結構，周圍一般血小板都很小，可判斷為巨大血小板（giant platelet）。
features: Central anucleate platelet approximately the size of adjacent red cells
Dense purple granules throughout with a finely fimbriated, irregular outline
Numerous scattered normal-sized small platelets for size comparison
A pale, round, faintly blue-grey cell at the top center, likely a polychromatophilic red cell
Background normocytic, normochromic red cells without significant poikilocytosis
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic, normochromic red cells with scattered small platelets and an occasional polychromatophilic red cell. In the center is an anucleate platelet approximately equal in diameter to the adjacent red cells, with densely packed purple granules and a fimbriated border. No leukocytes or platelet clumps are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with a giant platelet; clinical correlation with platelet count, MPV and history is recommended.

ddx.vs: A lymphocyte has a round dense nucleus surrounded by a thin rim of blue cytoplasm, whereas this structure is anucleate and diffusely granular.
Overlap shows a normal small platelet on top of a red cell with the red cell outline visible beneath, not an isolated red-cell-sized platelet.
A basophil is larger with a lobated nucleus beneath coarse dark granules and a defined cell membrane rather than a fimbriated platelet edge.
